description: This file implements an authentication service module in Python that manages user registration, login, password validation, and JWT handling within a backend project. It includes custom error classes, validation functions, and a main AuthService class with methods for registration, authentication, token creation, and token decoding.

classes.name: AuthServiceError
classes.description: Base class for authentication service errors.

classes.name: InvalidCredentialsError
classes.description: Raised when user credentials are invalid.

classes.name: AuthService
classes.description: Encapsulates user registration, authentication, and JWT operations, including password validation and token management.

methods.name: str _normalized_password(password: str)
methods.description: Sanitizes password input by stripping surrounding whitespace without altering internal content.

methods.name: bool _password_within_bcrypt_bounds(password: str)
methods.description: Checks if a password's UTF-8 byte length is within bcrypt bounds (8 to 72 bytes).

methods.name: User register_user(self, db: Session, *, email: str, password: str)
methods.description: Registers a new user with a normalized password after enforcing bcrypt byte-length constraints.

methods.name: Tuple[User,str] authenticate_user(self, db: Session, *, email: str, password: str)
methods.description: Authenticates user credentials and issues a JWT token if valid.

methods.name: str _create_access_token(self, *, subject: str)
methods.description: Generates a JWT token with a specified subject and expiration based on settings.

methods.name: TokenPayload decode_token(self, token: str)
methods.description: Decodes and validates a JWT token, raising exceptions if invalid or expired.

methods.name: Optional[User] get_user_by_id(self, db: Session, user_id: int)
methods.description: Retrieves a user by ID from the database session.

ctags.name: authenticate_user
ctags.pattern: /^    def authenticate_user(self, db: Session, *, email: str, password: str) -> Tuple[User, str]:$/
ctags.signature: (self, db: Session, *, email: str, password: str)

ctags.name: get_user_by_id
ctags.pattern: /^    def get_user_by_id(self, db: Session, user_id: int) -> Optional[User]:$/

ctags.name: register_user
ctags.pattern: /^    def register_user(self, db: Session, *, email: str, password: str) -> User:$/
ctags.signature: (self, db: Session, *, email: str, password: str)
